responsibility: This shell script generates configured GCC headers such as config.h, tconfig.h, bconfig.h, tm.h, libgcc_tm.h, and tm_p.h from environment-provided DEFINES, HEADERS, and optional TARGET_CPU_DEFAULT settings. It emits include guards, conditional host/build checks, ordered header inclusions including special tm.h handling for insn-flags and insn-modes, preserves files when contents are unchanged, and updates stamp files for make dependencies. Its role is build-time synthesis of GCC configuration headers.
